text: Reminder: the refreshed T&E expense policy 2026.1 takes effect 1 April and supersedes 2025.4. Key change is the per diem update and the 90-day reimbursement cutoff. Links pinned in <#C0TRV001|travel>.
Does the per diem change apply to trips already booked?
Only to travel dated 1 April onward. Anything before that stays on 2025.4.
Sector partners, Q1 pipeline review is next Thursday. I want the trackers current by Wednesday.
